capabilities: Render hierarchical mindmaps from indented code blocks
Draw bracket logic trees with grouping braces
Style diagrams with inline @ directives and an on-chart toolbar
Export diagrams as SVG, PNG or JPG into the vault
Lay out diagrams right-to-left, left-to-right, top-to-bottom or bottom-to-top
disambiguation: Not a freeform whiteboard or canvas; diagrams are generated from indented text inside code blocks.
extras: Command palette entries are prefixed "RTL Mindmap"; global styles can be overridden with a CSS snippet under Settings > Appearance > CSS snippets.
motivation: Built from the ground up to prevent indentation and alignment anomalies in right-to-left scripts.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to draw mindmaps or bracket logic trees from indented text, and right-to-left scripts often misalign in diagram tools.

relations.evidence: Install and enable the Obsidian42 - BRAT community plugin.

summary: SVG renderer that turns indented code blocks into mindmaps and bracket logic trees, with RTL support and SVG, PNG or JPG export.
